# Cloud App SDK archive

The scaffold pins the bundled `@tier0/sdk-v2@0.9.7` archive, which contains
platform, data, Stream request and real-time message APIs. It targets the Cloud
OpenAPI v2 contract. The lockfile and tests verify the archive integrity.

SHA256: `aa01c491c008a602d8dcbca2d66698e07ee05270edb4192cab7034b4a91e58e2`.
This bundled package uses Backend commit
`69b9dda5cbc6fcb447ddb752b656ec5a202a4ea6` for the `app-collections/2`
directory contract; it has not been published to the registry. See
`docs/collection-directory-release.md` for the coordinated release boundary.
SDK source commit: `c9d28fb8e1b286c469ab4096ad788894a244fdfc`.
Historical archives are retained for provenance and are
not installed by this scaffold. Updating the template does not update existing
Apps or prove deployment and live authorization.
